# Third-party code

- `tomlc99/` — TOML parser by CK Tan, **MIT**.
  Upstream: https://github.com/cktan/tomlc99
  Vendored as source files; the nested git directory was removed so the code is
  tracked by the main repository.

- `glad/glad.c` and `include/isogl/glad.h` — OpenGL loader generated by
  [glad](https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad) for a GL 4.6 core context.
  See the header for the generated license notice.
